notes.title: Patch 1.0.4 Released
notes.content:
Hello! Today, we released 1.0.4 which fixes a couple of crashes in specific locations:

- Certain encounters in Bunker Alpha were crashing
- A specific elevator in Silvington Base was crashing after arriving at a new floor and checking the panel again

Nothing too exciting, but for those affected by the above bugs, things should be more stable now. Thanks!

tags.bug: - Certain encounters in Bunker Alpha were crashing
- A specific elevator in Silvington Base was crashing after arriving at a new floor and checking the panel again

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3 Released
notes.content:
Patch 1.0.3 is out with some exciting changes! 

Gameplay:

- Most prominently, save files and the end game screen now show percentage complete, so you know roughly how many more secrets you need to find.
- Sidequests are less opaque, with more direction as to where you need to go to trigger certain things
- Slight map tweak in a later area to reduce backtracking

Bugs:

- Fixed a bug where Dexterity level 0 was actually more powerful than level 1
- Fixed an incorrect hint text


Balance:

- Many enemies in the final 1/3 of the game are beefier and less pushovers in general, including some HP and speed increases mainly
- Final dungeon bosses and enemies have been strengthened considerably

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2 Released
notes.content:
Version 1.0.2 is released with some very minor updates:

- Collision changes in Silvington base
- New railing tiles added in a few locations
- Fixed a specific softlock when accessing the vending machine

Next patches should have some more interesting content adjustments, so stay tuned!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1 Released
notes.content:
Hello Vast Future fans! After some initial feedback and bug reports, we have released the first post-release patch, which includes a couple of important fixes.

Fixes:
- Save games on files that completed the game no longer load in the middle of the credits
- Shoulder buttons on keyboard/gamepad are no longer 'stuck' on defaults even after customization
- Resistance % in INFO menu is no longer incorrect
- Glitch when trying to purchase any bullet over quantity of 99 in vending machine is fixed
- Slight fixes where dialogues had incorrect portraits

Tweaks/Balance:
- It is now possible to reset a Weapon Upgrade choice at Guy's
- The final boss encounters have been increased in difficulty
- Cursor wrapping in the SKILLS menu

As always, thanks for your feedback and we hope you enjoy the game!
